blocks.text: Analyn Barro has no qualms about potentially being sexualized for starring in the romantic comedy “He’s Dating a Bold Star,” saying she has now become comfortable with her sexy image. During the film’s recent media conference, Inquirer Entertainment asked Barro whether she had any concerns about being sexualized because of the film’s title and premise. “To be honest, hindi naman. Since ang second regular show ko sa GMA was Bubble Gang, and almost a decade na rin ako sa Bubble Gang. Naging training ground ko po siya,” she said.
